London local reflection panoramas

These HDR panoramas were rendered from the London scene at two heights near the Shard. They are an architectural interpretation, with no photographic scan textures added. The tower is excluded from its own reflection capture. The river uses a static rough surface and captured buildings omit shadows. The maps approximate nearby reflections; they do not reproduce moving traffic or exact reflection parallax.

Adapted panoramas: CC BY-SA 4.0. Smaller versions were averaged in linear radiance before encoding. Each lighting mode has source metadata and file hashes.
